title: Payroll Direct Deposit Reduction on the Pocketwire Personal Account Renewal Plan Fee
content:
The payroll-deposit reduction on the renewal plan fee of a Pocketwire Personal Account on monthly billing reads the direct deposits dated in the last month, a deposit counting when it is dated later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date:

- with 2 or more such deposits that together reach USD 2500.00, the reduction is 25 percent;
- with deposits that together reach the plan's direct-deposit benefit threshold without meeting both of those conditions, it is 10 percent;
- with neither, it is 0 percent.

"Reach" means at or above. The total of the deposits counted is 0.00 when none is counted.

### Direct-deposit benefit threshold by plan (USD)

| Pocketwire Lite | Pocketwire Core | Pocketwire Plus | Pocketwire Prime | Pocketwire Onyx | Pocketwire Summit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 0.00 |

### Condition table

| 2 or more deposits in the last month | Total at or above 2500.00 | Total at or above the plan's threshold | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 25 percent |
| Yes | No | Yes | 10 percent |
| No | Yes | Yes | 10 percent |
| No | No | Yes | 10 percent |
| Yes or no | No | No | 0 percent |

### Cases (hypothetical deposits)

- Handling date 15 June: a deposit dated 15 May is not counted; one dated 16 May is.
- Pocketwire Plus, three deposits totalling 2400.00: 10 percent — the total reaches 500.00 but not 2500.00.
- Pocketwire Prime, one deposit of 3000.00: 10 percent — fewer than 2 deposits.
- Pocketwire Onyx, two deposits totalling exactly 2500.00: 25 percent.
- Pocketwire Prime, deposits totalling 250.00: 0 percent — below 300.00.
- Pocketwire Summit, no deposit in the last month: the total of 0.00 reaches the threshold of 0.00, so 10 percent.
